messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired (P1) -> metrics.scrape.failure for prom-job 'exporter-node' · 3/5 scrape failures in last 2m
incident-bot: auto-escalation policy: page on-call and attempt auto-retry routing to replica cluster
pagerbot: PagerDuty: Incident #PD-4821 created and assigned to 'maria' (on-call) · ack to stop repeated pages
maria: acked. looking. can someone confirm customer impact? :eyes:
vikram: checking dashboards — scrape error rate spike, but host metrics still flowing to ingestion. logs show exporter 503s during scrape window.
samir: noticed increased 429s from exporter to k8s-proxy earlier, maybe burst shedding. bringing up curl to exporter endpoint now:
samir: ```curl -sv http://exporter-node.default.svc.cluster.local:9100/metrics | head -n 20```
alex: i can repro locally from one node — exporter responses are ~3.2s and timeout at 2s in Prom config. so prometheus marks as failed.
maria: OK, mitigation options: 1) increase scrape_timeout for job to 5s temporarily 2) restart exporter pods on nodes with highest latency 3) route Prom scrapes to warm replica cluster (has spare capacity). preferences?
vikram: prefer routing first to avoid pod churn. can we flip scrape target to prom-replica? ops-rotation has routing playbook?
ops-rotation: routing runbook: update scrape relabel to use endpoint 'exporter-node-replica' in prometheus-reload configmap, then POST /-/reload to prom. I'll hand the steps.
ops-rotation: ```kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap prometheus-scrape --patch '...replace job_array[2].static_configs[0].targets with exporter-node-replica:9100' && curl -s -X POST http://prometheus:9090/-/reload```
maria: can someone make that change? I'll prepare a PD status note for customers.
samir: i can run it. patching now. will wait 30s between reload and checks.
samir: applied patch and reloaded prometheus. watching target health.
vikram: after reload, Prom shows exporter-node-replica targets UP, scrape error rate falling. good sign.
alex: ops — we should also increase scrape_timeout to 4s across the job to avoid flaps while we investigate root cause. small change in configmap, can do in same window.
ops-rotation: applied timeout bump to 4s and reloaded.
maria: update to PD: "Investigation: exporter node 503/latency causing Prom scrape failures. Mitigation: routed scrapes to replica cluster and increased scrape_timeout. Monitoring for 15m. No customer-facing query failures observed so far; reduced alert noise. On-call: maria."
pagerbot: PD incident updated: note added and incident severity remains P1 pending stability check.
vikram: digging into exporter: CPU spikes on a subset of nodes at scrape intervals, looks like an expensive collector plugin. logs show repeated stack traces in exporter process.
samir: restarting exporter on affected nodes to clear state and cause fallback to replica once they come back. I'll restart one at a time.
samir: restarted exporter on node-7 — target briefly down then back up and stable.
alex: can we mark this as 'mitigated' in PD and switch to monitoring-only if no regress in 30m?
maria: agree. leaving incident open for 30m monitoring window. assigning to vikram and samir for postmortem/triage. I'll handoff to next on-call in 20m.
ops-rotation: quick note for postmortem: collect exporter versions, collector flags, node CPU profiles during spike.
vikram: +1. also suggest we add a temporary circuit-breaker in promo routing to avoid scraping same overloaded nodes.
maria: thanks all. will post a short recap to #general after monitoring window if stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Automation: will auto-close if no new alerts in 30m or escalate to PD if error rate returns above threshold.
